title: Effect of a control action
statement: Let a three-work-tape Turing-machine configuration have input head position $p$, work tapes $T_0,T_1,T_2$, work-head positions $h_0,h_1,h_2$, and output string $O$. A control action that moves the input head by $im$, makes no changes to the work tapes or their head positions, emits the optional bit $o$, and sets the state to $q$ produces the configuration with state $q$, input head at the clamped position obtained by moving $p$ by $im$, the same work tapes and work-head positions, and output $O$ followed by $o$ if present.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input word w and its input-head position p
Three Boolean work tapes tp and their head positions hd
Initial state q′ and successor state q
